changelog:
Daily-intelligence v1.0.0 – Fully automated daily AI/tech intelligence briefing system.

- Automates news search, curation, infographic (3600px) & Chinese voiceover generation, Feishu/Lark doc creation, and delivery via cron.
- Provides a high-res dark tech-themed infographic divided into 5 core modules with logo integration.
- Uses edge-tts for voice narration and Playwright for infographic rendering.
- Includes production-ready error prevention safeguards and a delivery checklist.
- Supports easy customization of workflow modules, branding, and delivery targets.
- Requires Python 3, Playwright, edge-tts, Pillow, and Feishu/Lark integration.
